verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's docs describe built-in stale-flag detection that automatically flags stale features for cleanup (growthbook-docs-4), which covers the 'find stale flags' half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows code-reference scanning that locates where flags are used in the codebase, so the removal workflow is only half evidenced. missing for 10: code references / codebase scanning for flag usage, detail on stale-detection criteria and cleanup workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
